messages.content: You are a chat template generator. Analyze conversations and create reusable templates. You must call save_chat_template exactly once with the generated template. Do not respond with plain text. Please ensure using user's preferred language inside conversation.

Analyze the conversation and generate a reusable chat template. Extract the core purpose, create a concise name, suggest an appropriate emoji, and write a system prompt that captures the essence of the conversation pattern.

[conversation context]
Help me plan a four day Kyoto trip focused on temples, vegetarian food, and a tight budget.

Please optimize for walking routes, train passes, and one rainy day backup plan.

[response context]
I can build a day by day Kyoto itinerary with transit advice, low-cost stays, and vegetarian restaurant ideas.

Understood. I will prioritize clustered neighborhoods, JR and subway pass guidance, and indoor backups.

emoji.description: Single emoji representing the template purpose.

inherit_app_prompt.description: Whether the template should inherit the application-wide system prompt.

name.description: Short descriptive name for the template using concise language.

prompt.description: System prompt that captures the conversation pattern and purpose.
